items.excerpt: Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo wareegto soo saaray ayaa guddoomiyeyaal u magacaabay degmooyinka Ceel-buh iyo Baraagaha-qol ee gobollada Sanaag & Haylaan. Cabdisalaan Qaalib Dalmar Ciise ayaa loo magacaabay guddoomiyaha degmada Baraagaha-qol ee gobolka Haylaan, halka guddoomiye ku xigeenka degmadaas loo magacaabay Ceegaag Maxamed Yuusuf. Sidoo kale waxaa Maxamed Axmed Cali loo magacaabay guddoomiyaha degmada Ceel-buh ee gobolka Sanaag, halka ku xigeenka laga dhigay Cali Faarax Ismaaciil. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa magaabistan sameeyay, kaddib talo-soo-jeedin ka timid wasaaradda arrimaha gudaha Puntland, sida lagu sheegay wareegtada. Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa bishii Sebteembar ee sanadkii hore 2025, xeer madaxweyne ku dhisay laba degmo ee Ceel-buh iyo Baraagaha-qol.

items.excerpt: Madaxweynaha Puntland Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa maanta xarunta madaxtooyada kulan kula yeeshay guddoonka baarlamaanka, kaas oo looga hadlay wax-ka-baddelka. Kulanka waxaa lagu soo bandhigay xog ururin la sheegay in ay ka soo baxday wadatashiyo lala yeeshay qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Puntland, taas oo quseysa qodobada wax-ka-bedelka lagu sameynayo ee dastuurka Puntland. Kulanka waxaa ka qaybgalay guddiga baarlamaanka u qaabilsan qiimeynta wax-ka-bedelka dastuurka, guddiga doorashooyinka Puntland, xubno ka tirsan golaha wasiirada iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Golaha xukuumadda ayaa hore baarlamaanka ugu soo gubiyay hindisaha wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, waana markii labaad oo madaxweyne Deni soo gudbiyo wax-ka-baddel dastuur tan iyo intii uu hayay hoggaanka Puntland. Qaar ka ka mid siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka Puntland ayaa diidan wax-kabaddelka dastuurka, iyada oo wax-ka-beddelkii hore ee 2023 uu sababay dagaal ay dad badan ku dhinteen oo ka dhacay Garoowe.

items.description: The assessment covered 758 households across temporary displacement sites and host communities in Moyale . Nearly all households surveyed (96%) had fled Ethiopia , mainly from the Oromia and Somali regions. Nine in 10 respondents said their entire village had fled, indicating the extensive scale of displacement. Children account for more than half of the displaced population, including a significant number under the age of five, raising concerns over their health and well-being amid worsening living conditions.
